what: GroundingDINO removal from the gRefCOCO path (operator directive 2026-10-18; search-until-it-works directive 2026-10-20)

class_floor.source: SELF1E-8B (cIoU, CVPR 2026 arXiv:2603.19026; raised from PSALM 42.0 by the escalation rule) / PSALM (gIoU, ECCV 2024 arXiv:2403.14598)

arms.name: vlm_box_sam_union
arms.description: per-clause and per-noun VLM boxes; sxi pool picks inside each box unioned with SAM ViT-H box-prompted masks from the same VLM boxes (SAM predicted-IoU floor and area cap); three-prompt abstention; pair/union fallback. No GroundingDINO anywhere.
arms.setting: training-free (config selected on the held-out train-tune split)
arms.boxes_source: LLaVA-OneVision-7B clause + noun boxes; SAM ViT-H box-prompted masks

arms.name: searched_clause_pool_only
arms.description: previous DINO-free best: clause-box sxi picks over the SAM-H pool, no box-prompted SAM
arms.boxes_source: LLaVA clause boxes; precomputed SAM-H pool only

arms.name: base_noun_pool_only
arms.description: noun-box sxi picks over the SAM-H pool, no box-prompted SAM
arms.boxes_source: LLaVA noun boxes; SAM-H pool only

search.objective: official cIoU on tune rows (abstention included)
search.search_type: random search over source/base/sxi/cap/SAM top-k/SAM score floor/p_sel plus anchors

detector_bearing_ablation.name: detector-bearing pool+detector-box SAM rule (not shipped)
detector_bearing_ablation.note: measured cost of removing GroundingDINO on the same records

alignment.reference: the detector-bearing rule is retained only as an ablation

verdict: A DINO-free arm clears both same-class floors: VLM clause/noun boxes plus SAM box-prompted masks reach 47.59 cIoU / 73.78 gIoU on the full official val split (N-acc 85.66). It is shipped as the gRefCOCO row; GroundingDINO leaves the path. The detector-bearing ablation is 50.34/74.69, so removing the detector costs 2.76 cIoU / 0.91 gIoU. The leap over the previous DINO-free best (40.56 cIoU, pool-only) comes from box-prompted SAM masks on VLM boxes, which the DINO-free path had never used.
